rejected_rule.statement: The ownership of lot 7 remains with the Appellant and the 2nd to 6th Respondents.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: Hence the ownership of lot 7, at the time relevant to the matter in question of this case, was remained on the Appellant and the 2nd to 6th Respondents.
rejected_rule.statute_citation_verbatim: section 33 of the Land Acquisition Act No. 09 of 1950
